changes.title: Girls Und Panzer Voice Pack Mod for World of Tanks

previous.changeLog:
v2.3.0.1 #10 (28-06-2026):
- Updated contour icons: man1aq
- Updated enhanced modsSettingsApi 1.4.1 (new option for mod authors)
- Updated Custom Sixth Sense (added a support for a replays)
- Updated Crew Skills Pro (added a support for a replays)
- Updated In Battle Statistics (settings now survive reinstallation)
- Updated majority of CHAMPi's mods
- Updated Research Progress Bar
- Removed Damage Panel: Better (it wasn`t working after all)
- Added Hitmarker Pro (by Aslain) [mod #683] (replaces the old Hitmarker 2.0): shows a marker on your crosshair whenever you hit an enemy, with its own colour for each hit type, adjustable size, animated or static style and an optional hit sound, all set up in the garage (Mod configurator menu). Your previous Hitmarker selection is not carried over, so re-select it and configure it there. The mod can be found in the crosshairs branch, where you have to re-select it again.
